hook: Filmed from a rover being lowered onto Mars on cables.
narration: This camera rode a rover down to Mars, dangling on cables under a rocket-powered crane.
The footage starts seven miles above Jezero Crater, the moment the parachute opened.
It was the most massive parachute ever sent to another world, and it opened at supersonic speed.
Then the heat shield fell away, and the rover saw the ground for the first time.
Mars was so far away that radio signals took minutes to reach Earth, so every step of this landing ran on its own.
Near the surface, the descent stage fired its rockets and lowered the rover on cables.
[short pause] Its engines blasted a cloud of dust up around the wheels.
outcome: Perseverance touched down in Jezero Crater, the fifth rover NASA has landed on Mars.
title: Landing on Mars, filmed from the rover
description:
Cameras aboard NASA's Perseverance rover and its descent stage filmed the final minutes of its landing in Jezero Crater on Mars on Feb. 18, 2021, from parachute inflation to touchdown.

Footage: NASA video, via the NASA Image and Video Library: https://images.nasa.gov/details/NHQ_2021_0222_VF_NASA%20Provides%20First%20Front-Row%20Seat%20to%20Perseverance%20Rover%E2%80%99s%20Landing%20on%20Mars
